name: Tropica Island Resort

address.street: Private bay on Malolo Island Malolo Island

insider_take: This adults-only tropical paradise sits on its own private island in the stunning Mamanuca archipelago, where pristine coral reefs meet powder-soft beaches just 35 minutes from Nadi.
whats_special: Tropica Island Resort is built around a unique lagoon-style swimming pool that winds through the property like a lazy river. The resort sits on Malolo Island, home to some of Fiji's most vibrant coral gardens and the filming location for the reality TV show "Treasure Island." Each of the 26 traditional Fijian bures features hand-carved details by local artisans.
pro_tip: Book the sunset sailing trip – the Mamanuca Islands offer some of the world's most spectacular sunsets, and you'll often spot dolphins and manta rays along the way.
dont_miss: The traditional Fijian kava ceremony at sunset, snorkeling at the nearby Rainbow Reef (accessible by complimentary kayak), and the weekly Meke cultural dance performance under the stars. The resort's house reef is perfect for beginners and teems with tropical fish just steps from your bure.
pros: Adults-only boutique resort with intimate atmosphere
Exceptional snorkeling and diving access to pristine coral reefs
Traditional Fijian cultural experiences and warm hospitality
All-inclusive dining featuring fresh local seafood and tropical cuisine
cons: Adults-only policy excludes families with children
Remote island location requires boat transfers
